note: Index definitions only. An index is offered as 'available' solely after a maintainer has verified legal access to its constituent list and recorded the source, as-of date and licensing. No constituent list has been verified yet, so all three are 'unavailable' and carry no symbols. Never fill 'constituents' from memory or from an unlicensed copy.

indices.name: S&P 500

methodology.summary: A float-adjusted, market-capitalization-weighted index of large US-listed companies, chosen by an index committee using size, liquidity, domicile, profitability and other published eligibility rules. Membership is a committee decision, not a ranking of the best investments.

constituent_source.name: S&P Dow Jones Indices constituent file (licensed)

indices.unavailable_reason: The official constituent list is licensed by S&P Dow Jones Indices and no licence or redistributable copy has been verified. FloweySales does not reconstruct it from memory or from unlicensed copies.
indices.licensing: Index data is proprietary to the provider. Redistribution of constituents and weights needs a licence. Not verified.
indices.exclusions: Some companies have more than one share class; how many lines count is set by the provider's rules. The constituent count can differ from the name (500).
indices.share_class_policy: Multiple share classes of one company are separate securities; they are merged by canonical identity (ISIN or exchange plus ticker) in a combined universe, never by ticker alone.

history.note: No point-in-time membership is available. Past rankings and backtests on today's members suffer survivorship and selection bias.

indices.benchmark_note: ^GSPC is the price index and excludes dividends; a total-return comparison needs a separate total-return series.

indices.name: Nasdaq-100

methodology.summary: An index of large non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market, weighted by modified market capitalization and reviewed on a published schedule. Financial companies are excluded by rule. Membership is rule-based and is not a ranking of the best investments.

indices.unavailable_reason: No verified licence or redistributable copy of the constituent list is available to FloweySales. It is not reconstructed from memory.
indices.licensing: Index data is proprietary to the provider. Redistribution needs a licence. Not verified.
indices.exclusions: Financial companies are excluded by the index rules. Some companies have more than one share class, so the number of securities can exceed 100.
indices.share_class_policy: Multiple share classes of one company are separate securities; they are merged by canonical identity (ISIN or exchange plus ticker) in a combined universe, never by ticker alone.

history.note: No point-in-time membership is available. Past rankings and backtests on today's members suffer survivorship and selection bias.

indices.benchmark_note: ^NDX is the price index and excludes dividends.

indices.name: OMX Stockholm 30 (OMXS30)

methodology.summary: A market-capitalization-weighted index of the 30 most traded shares on Nasdaq Stockholm, reviewed twice a year on published rules. Membership follows trading volume rules, not quality, and is not a ranking of the best investments.

constituent_source.name: Nasdaq Nordic index constituent list (licensing unverified)

indices.unavailable_reason: No verified licence or redistributable copy of the constituent list is available to FloweySales. The hand-picked 'Swedish large caps' list is a different, curated list and is not OMXS30.
indices.licensing: Index data is proprietary to the provider. Redistribution needs a licence. Not verified.
indices.exclusions: Companies with more than one share class (for example A and B shares) may appear with one or more lines, set by the provider's rules. Prices are in SEK; comparison with other currencies needs an FX source that is not integrated.
indices.share_class_policy: Multiple share classes are separate securities with exchange-qualified symbols (suffix .ST); they are merged by canonical identity, never by ticker alone.

history.note: No point-in-time membership is available. Past rankings and backtests on today's members suffer survivorship and selection bias.

indices.benchmark_note: The benchmark symbol is a price index in SEK and excludes dividends. It has not been verified as available from every market-data provider.
